_about: Ryth's short-term rental rating for each Monroe County municipality, shown as the colored map and the table on the investing guide. green = easier, yellow = possible, with limits, red = very difficult. 'why' is the one-line reason shown in the table. Change asOf whenever a rating changes.

Barrett township.why: Allowed with a township permit. The township is reviewing its ordinance, so check for changes before you buy.

Middle Smithfield township.why: Allowed with a township permit and occupancy limits. Close to Shawnee Mountain, the Delaware Water Gap and Bushkill Falls.

Tobyhanna township.why: Allowed with a township license, for up to 2 people per bedroom plus 2. The township lifted its cap on licenses in 2025.

Tunkhannock township.why: Allowed with a permit and inspection, including in residential communities such as parts of Emerald Lakes and Indian Mountain Lakes.

Eldred township.why: Allowed only in some zoning districts, and only with a conditional use the township approves case by case.

Jackson township.why: New licenses only in the recreation/commercial, commercial, conservation and village districts, not in residential areas.

Polk township.why: The revised ordinance keeps rentals out of residential neighborhoods. Confirm any existing license with the township before you buy.

Price township.why: No short-term rental ordinance yet, so the rules are unsettled. A zoning approval protects you if limits come later.

Stroud township.why: Allowed only in the C-3 district, with exceptions for the Penn Estates and Blue Mountain Lake communities. Permit and inspection required.

Chestnuthill township.why: Allowed only on properties in a general commercial zone, with a permit.

Coolbaugh township.why: The township tightened its rules in 2025, including where rentals are allowed and septic requirements, and many homes are in private communities with their own rental rules.

Delaware Water Gap borough.why: Allowed only in a very small section of the borough, with a license.

East Stroudsburg borough.why: Licenses are limited to commercial and industrial zones. A home in a residential area needs a variance or conditional use.

Hamilton township.why: Not allowed in the township's residential areas. In a commercial zone it needs zoning board approval as a hotel or motel use.

Mount Pocono borough.why: Allowed only in the C-1 and C-2 commercial districts. New licenses in the R-2 district ended in 2023.

Paradise township.why: Allowed only in the business (resort development) districts, not in residential areas.

Pocono township.why: Allowed only in the Commercial and Recreational districts, with an annual license, an inspection and $500,000 in liability insurance.

Ross township.why: Allowed only in general commercial and village commercial zones, not in residential areas.

Smithfield township.why: Allowed only in the resort district, which is mostly Shawnee Mountain and the former Shawnee Village.

Stroudsburg borough.why: Not allowed in the residential districts (R-1, R-2 and R-3). Elsewhere a license and a yearly inspection are required.
